messages:
Sam L: BOS capacity lab is provisioned — 8 reserved GPU nodes (bos-1a). I kicked off initial preflight. Can someone run the acceptance checklist and flag anything blocking handoff to ops? @Priya @Carlos
Priya M: On it. I'll do driver + container images + basic perf probes. ETA 20m.
Carlos R: I'll handle network baselines and cost quick-scan. Note: spot pools in this region are inconsistent so reserved was the right call.
Sam L: Confirmed reserved nodes only. Billing project: eng-bos-eval. Keep cost notes in the thread.
Priya M: Driver check done. Ran: ```ssh root@bos-gpu-01 sudo nvidia-smi``` -> "Driver 535.54, 8 GPUs, temps 45C avg, no ECC errors". Kernel modules present, docker images pre-pulled to 10.0.1.0/24 nodes.
infra-bot: smoke-tests: gpu-driver ✅, docker-images ✅, node-exporter ✅, ntp-sync ✅
Carlos R: Network baseline: intra-node iperf3 (8 parallel streams) ~72 Gbps aggregate. Egress to S3 from single node peaked 850 MB/s. No packet loss on internal links.
Ellen K: Runtime sanity: cold start med 20ms, p95 46ms at idle. Ramped to 500 RPS; observed p95 climb to ~120ms, error rate ~0.6% (target <0.5%). Logging shows transient queue backpressure.
Carlos R: Root cause: inference queue bottleneck when GPU pool saturates. Autoscaler target was at 80% GPU util. Lowered HPA target to 65% to give headroom. Patch: ```kubectl patch hpa inference --patch '{"spec":{"targetCPUUtilizationPercentage":65}}'``` (applied).
Priya M: Re-ran the 500 RPS load after HPA tweak: error rate dropped to 0.2%, p95 now ~92ms. No GPU OOMs in logs. ✅
Sam L: Cost sanity check: reserved rate ~ $18/GPU-hour. If we run 24/7 full capacity (~8 GPUs) rough monthly = ~$104k. Carlos, can you draft a 30/60/90 day ramp scenario for finance with committed discount variations?
Carlos R: Will produce a spreadsheet. Quick roughs: 10%/30%/60% utilization ramps -> ~$10.4k / $31k / $62k incremental per month (before discounts). I'll include burst and mixed spot/reserved scenarios.
Ellen K: SLO gates (current): latency p95 <150ms => PASS, error rate <0.5% => PASS (post-fix), GPU OOMs = 0 => PASS. Any outstanding infra validation items?
Priya M: A few follow-ups: 1) We're single-AZ right now; validate cross-AZ failover next. 2) Bastion host egress is too permissive — restrict to known jump IPs. 3) Validate KMS key rotation path for this billing project.
Sam L: Agreed. Let's schedule a DR/failover drill (cross-AZ) during low-traffic window Thurs 03/26 02:00 UTC. For handoff, open an Eng-Infra ticket with runbook, spreadsheet, and oncall tag. @infra-bot create-ticket
infra-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-7895 "BOS cross-AZ failover trial". Assignee: Ellen K. Planned window Thu 03/26 02:00 UTC.
Priya M: Audit: KMS keys attached, logs streaming to central ELK, network ACLs non-public for worker subnets. One outstanding: bastion allows outbound 0.0.0.0/0 — recommend limiting to corp jump IPs and ops CIDR.
Carlos R: Noted for the handoff. I'll attach the cost spreadsheet and include a committed discount appendix.
Sam L: Handoff checklist for INFRA-7895: attach runbook link, attach cost spreadsheet, tag oncall, schedule DR window, confirm bastion egress rule update, confirm KMS rotation docs. Once tasks are complete we can close this thread. Thanks everyone.
